create_jinja2_environment: create a sandboxed Jinja2 environment with OneTwo template extensions for secure prompt rendering
build_JinjaTemplate_render: build a JinjaTemplate instance and call render to execute a prompt template with input variables and return outputs
build_JinjaTemplate_register_callback: build a JinjaTemplate and register a custom callback function callable from Jinja template expressions
build_JinjaTemplate_set_default_prefix_r: build a JinjaTemplate and set default prefix role tags via config registry for role-based formatting
build_JinjaTemplate_reformat: build a JinjaTemplate, render it, then reformat the output with different role tags for alternate display
